meta.name: data-scientist
meta.description: Expert data processing specialist with intelligent DuckDB/Polars selection for maximum performance. Always includes numpy, never uses pandas, runs everything through uv. Triggers: 'analyze the data', 'analyze this file', 'what is in this CSV/parquet/json', 'summarize this', 'group by', 'filter rows', 'sort by', 'join these files', 'merge datasets', 'time series trend', 'last 30 days data', 'compare yesterday and today', 'distribution/histogram', 'correlation', 'clean duplicates', 'handle missing values', 'dataset larger than RAM', 'SQL query on files', 'DataFrame operations', 'chart/plot this data', DuckDB vs Polars selection, quick data exploration CLI. NOT for plain text/code inspection, configs, or tiny inline math.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析 CSV、Parquet 等数据文件,完成汇总、筛选与关联统计
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果面对数据文件想快速搞清规律和统计结果
copy.tagline_en: Analyze CSV, Parquet, and JSON files to summarize, filter, and join data
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often work with data files and want quick insights without complex coding

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 处理数据时自动在 DuckDB 与 Polars 间选型,通过 uv 运行,总是包含 numpy 和 pyarrow,绝不用 pandas;能直接查询文件,执行过滤、排序、聚合、连接,需要可视化时加入 matplotlib,并报告耗时与行数。
howto.when: 当你说“分析这个文件”、“汇总一下”、“按类别分组”等,或要求对 CSV、Parquet、JSON 等数据文件做查询、过滤、清洗等操作时触发;不适用于纯文本、配置或简单心算。

say.text: 分析这个 CSV 文件,按类别统计销售额。
say.note: 它会选型并返回分组汇总结果。

say.text: 对比昨天和今天的数据,找出差异最大的前10项。
这个数据集超过内存,用流式方式处理。
say.note: 采用 Polars 流式或 DuckDB 外核。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude auto-selects DuckDB or Polars, runs via uv, always includes numpy and pyarrow, never uses pandas. It can query files directly, filter, sort, aggregate, join, add matplotlib for plots, and reports time and row counts.
howto.when_en: Triggers on phrases like 'analyze this file', 'summarize this', 'group by', or requests to query/filter/clean CSV, Parquet, JSON files. Not for plain text, configs, or simple math.

say_en.text: Analyze this CSV and sum sales by category.
say_en.note: It picks the engine and returns aggregated results.

say_en.text: Compare yesterday and today, show top 10 differences.
This dataset is larger than RAM; process it streaming.
say_en.note: Uses Polars streaming or DuckDB out-of-core.
